company.name: Plexium
company.shortDescription: Plexium develops a targeted protein degradation platform to find new therapies for cancer and other diseases.
company.description: Plexium develops a targeted protein degradation platform to find new therapies for cancer and other diseases. Plexium's platform focuses on the discovery of next-generation TPD drugs that extend beyond the limited applications of Proteolysis Targeting Chimeras (PROTACs) and cereblon imids, unraveling the boundless possibilities of true drug-like protein degraders. From molecular glues to monovalent degraders, the possibilities are endless across a wide variety of therapeutic areas.

aiResearchSummary.text: Plexium is researching small molecule compounds and pharmaceutical compositions such as spirocycloalkyl, cycloalkyl, heterocycloalkyl and aryl compounds that modulate cereblon activity and degrade IKAROS zinc finger proteins, as described in titles on IKZF2 modulators. They also pursue compounds that degrade SMARCA chromatin regulators, cyclin dependent kinase two, and bromodomain BRD4, plus assay devices for combinatorial libraries, highlighting targeted protein degradation, epigenetic regulator degradation, kinase degradation, and high throughput screening.
